description: This file defines the kernel object core framework for Zephyr RTOS, including object type definitions, core structures, and statistics APIs.

methods.name: z_obj_type_init
methods.description: Initializes a specific object type and links it into the framework.

methods.name: k_obj_type_find
methods.description: Finds an object type by its ID.

methods.name: k_obj_type_walk_locked
methods.description: Walks the list of object cores with synchronization.

methods.name: k_obj_type_walk_unlocked
methods.description: Walks the list of object cores without synchronization.

methods.name: k_obj_core_init
methods.description: Initializes a kernel object core with a specific object type.

methods.name: k_obj_core_link
methods.description: Links a kernel object into the object type list.

methods.name: k_obj_core_init_and_link
methods.description: Initializes and links a kernel object.

methods.name: k_obj_core_unlink
methods.description: Unlinks a kernel object from its type list.

methods.name: k_obj_type_stats_init
methods.description: Initializes the statistics descriptor for an object type.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_init
methods.description: Initializes the statistics for an object core.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_register
methods.description: Registers a kernel object for statistics gathering.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_deregister
methods.description: Deregisters a kernel object from statistics gathering.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw statistics from a kernel object.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_query
methods.description: Retrieves calculated statistics from a kernel object.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_reset
methods.description: Resets statistics for a kernel object.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_disable
methods.description: Stops gathering statistics for a kernel object.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_enable
methods.description: Resumes gathering statistics for a kernel object.
